benchmark.note: The NZ benchmark list (Red Rocks, Kapiti, Lake Coleridge, Sumner, etc.) is New Zealand specific and does not apply to this NSW region; the generic checks below do.

Mount York (roadside lookout/memorial, no counted source) rejected
Small town museums (Colonial Inn, Crystal Kingdom, Mount Victoria Museum) rejected
Gateway village Glenbrook (draw is the park beyond it) sent to review like Pipiriki
benchmark.vehicle_rule: Zig Zag Railway is kept as the place (the Zig Zag at Clarence), not as a ride; Scenic World is a place with its own boardwalks.
benchmark.recurring_events: no festival, once-a-week market or event was kept; Hill End, Gulgong etc. are permanent places.
benchmark.parks: every national park (Blue Mountains, Wollemi, Kanangra-Boyd, Gardens of Stone, Warrumbungle, Abercrombie River, Coolah Tops, Weddin Mountains) is proposed as a destination; Goobang and Conimbla are in review as rarely visited.

summary_five_lines: Placed 38 spots: 37 under 15 proposed destinations (none exists in the app yet) and 1 standalone (Hill End); 10 kept places held for no photo; 11 kept parks/cities become proposed destinations.

Lowest kept: views 0 with 1 counted source (Giant Stairway, RFDS Dubbo Visitor Experience); Wellington Caves and Blue Mountains Botanic Garden score 0 counted sources but were upgraded on Wikivoyage and operator pages.

Every higher-scoring candidate left out has a concrete reason: 27 in review (closed Jenolan Caves and National Pass, hotel Hydro Majestic, private Mount Wilson gardens, no source naming Capertee Valley, rarely visited parks) and rejects (overlap, nothing distinctive, minor memorial).

Strongest outsiders: Jenolan Caves (12,622 views, closed until early 2027), Capertee Valley (12,883, no source names it), Kandos (8,826, museum only), Hydro Majestic (12,056, hotel); none lacks a "What qualifies" reason.
Benchmark: negative benchmarks respected; NZ positive benchmarks do not apply; recommendation accept.
